basic_info.description: A new level of modern luxury, SHIPLEY HOUSE sets the precedent for luxurious living in San Francisco. Comprised of stunning one- and two-bedroom floor plans, these 15 homes are thoughtfully designed by Chris Miniello of Birch and Tailor. Interiors reveal sophisticated kitchens, wide-plank hardwood flooring and carefully curated finishes. Sleek contemporary interiors with designer kitchens and baths, soaring high ceilings, wide plank hardwood flooring and expansive European Trespa panels and custom window systems highlight these amazing new homes.
